feature_contract.goal: Connect the production R23 host's game-authored D3D11 independent-eye DirectGPU hold sources into real OpenXR projection and cached-frame decisions, rather than inadvertently gating them against unpopulated legacy main.cpp snapshot textures; keep original D3D9/input and SBS fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: R23 production OpenXR renders genuine independently committed left and right DirectGPU hold SRVs even if older main.cpp directSnapshot SRVs were never initialized.
Partial or absent R23 direct hold cannot masquerade as true stereo; valid classic SBS retains its path and original D3D9 gamepad and FFB are unaffected.
Mandatory DX11 Fast, Backend, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD Inspector GitHub Actions all verify one exact final candidate SHA without claims of HMD/gameplay observations.

integration_path: Already present game D3D9 Draw/DrawIndexed bridge fills the producer's full-size native D3D11 game color resource; previous two-eye ring producer records GPU eyes with identity/fence safeguards

R23 x64 host commits two separate DirectGPU source textures into owned eye hold SRVs; production OpenXR projection and frame-grace selection now use that actual pair and return to verified classic SBS where necessary
batch_components: vrhost/src/main_r23.cpp real built R23 OpenXR compositor source routing and grace-frame activation
vrhost/tests/native_direct_eye_pair_smoke.cpp actual DirectGPU/native eye source and fail-closed source-fallback regression

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Two independent host-owned R23 DirectGPU eye hold resources reach the real x64 OpenXR projection routing without legacy private snapshot allocation.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Missing either R23 DirectGPU eye denies native source; an independently validated classic SBS source remains eligible and ordinary game Draw/input is not intercepted or suppressed.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Existing 32-bit live-game native Draw producer and OpenXR x64 R23 hold textures are connected at projection admission rather than legacy main.cpp-only snapshot gate; CI exact SHA pending.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Source/CI-only production OpenXR projection correction. Actual menu, car selection, sustained race picture, independent pose and Quest3 performance remain unobserved.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native full-game producer requires explicit diagnostic opts and validated two-eye DirectGPU transport. Failing or partial native source reverts to classic SBS where proven and preserves original D3D9 rendering/gamepad/FFB.
